Act Summary text: Basic cooperative society registration rules and society structure guidelines.
TDS Deduction: The society must deduct TDS when paying third-party service providers (e.g. Section 194C 1% or 2% for contractors if payments exceed ₹30
GST (18%) is applicable only if the society total annual turnover exceeds ₹20 Lakhs AND individual member monthly maintenance exceeds ₹7

Societies must follow Double-Entry Accrual Accounting. Financial Year runs strictly from April 1 to March 31. Audit reports and balance sheet submissions to the Registrar of Cooperative Societies are mandatory.
Monthly maintenance charges are Mutual Incomes (Exempt from Income Tax). Sinking Fund is typically 0.25% per annum of construction cost or per-sq-ft rate.
Society must capture vendor PAN for TDS and GSTIN if applicable. TDS rules apply on vendor vouchers generated.
Opening balances for the new financial year. Double-entry engine ensures closing balances from last FY carry forward. Dr and Cr balances must be equal.
